Moving `get_failure_reason` and `get_monitor_environment_context` out of `mark_failed` likely leaves callers broken, so I'm reporting one test-gap finding:

```json
{"findings": [{"file": "src/sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py", "line": 79, "severity": "medium", "category": "test_gap", "title": "Removed symbols may break existing imports and test mocks", "body": "`get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `mark_failed_threshold` and `SimpleCheckIn` were removed from `mark_failed.py` and moved elsewhere. `create_issue_platform_occurrence` was also renamed to `create_incident_occurrence`. No compatibility re-exports were left behind, and no test files were updated in this PR. Existing tests that patch `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.produce_occurrence_to_kafka` will stop intercepting the call, because the import now happens in `incident_occurrence.py`. Tests or other modules that import these names from `mark_failed` will fail with ImportError."}]}
```

findings.title: Removed symbols may break existing imports and test mocks
findings.body: `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `mark_failed_threshold` and `SimpleCheckIn` were removed from `mark_failed.py` and moved elsewhere. `create_issue_platform_occurrence` was also renamed to `create_incident_occurrence`. No compatibility re-exports were left behind, and no test files were updated in this PR. Existing tests that patch `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.produce_occurrence_to_kafka` will stop intercepting the call, because the import now happens in `incident_occurrence.py`. Tests or other modules that import these names from `mark_failed` will fail with ImportError.
